_comment: UEnderEncounterDefinition assets. Wave plans come from the engine-free rules (EnderRules::PlanEncounter) seeded from the run seed; these assets only choose the room kind, the roster and the per-room seed offset. Service room indices: Room1-4 = 0-3, shrine = 5, elite = 6, boss = 7.
_rosterNote: AllowedArchetypes is written only when bOverrideAllowedArchetypes is true; by default the rules decide the roster from RoomKind. The lists above document the first-Realm progression and are applied with --override-rosters.
